quick_notes.title: Target Score
quick_notes.detail: Aim for 170+ / 200. Focus on Language first (usually easier).
quick_notes.explanation: To pass this exam, you should try to get at least 170 marks out of a total of 200. The English Language section is usually easier than the other sections, so you should focus on practising it first to build your confidence and score well. The exam has different parts, and by concentrating on the Language part, you can collect many marks without needing deep knowledge of other subjects. Remember, your main goal is to reach 170 or more, so choose the easiest section to master first.

quick_notes.title: OMR Strategy
quick_notes.detail: Shade carefully. Use the last 15 mins for any leftover questions.
quick_notes.explanation: OMR stands for Optical Mark Recognition. It is the answer sheet used in TNPSC exams where you fill in small circles next to your chosen answers. You must shade the entire circle darkly and neatly using only the pen or pencil allowed, because the machine reads the darkness and a light or messy mark may be skipped. A good strategy is to leave difficult questions blank during the first pass and then use the last 15 minutes of the exam time to go back, choose your best answer, and shade those circles carefully.
